disagreements.determination: compound-claim severity disagreement; human unclear, model unsupported
conflicting-evidence boundary disagreement; human unsupported, model unclear

_meta.methodology: Independent held-out semantic-groundedness set created after Slice 15C1 Phase 1 commit 936a74a08e3e5d20fc0e93e55cee4fbc0102f4b8 froze the grader contract, prompt semantic_groundedness.v1, closed score-to-label mapping, and 0.70 mean threshold. Cases are newly authored research-style claim/excerpt pairs and do not copy candidate_goldens.v1. Proposed labels were assigned to the assembled grader input (including truncation) using only the committed mapping, before any live model prediction. The project owner approved these labels on 2026-08-13. Approval occurred before predictions. Labels must not change after predictions. Report-level pass is the Atlas arithmetic mean of per-claim approved scores, with empty claims scoring 1.00. No private data, secrets, URLs, or production logs are included. Live calibration ran on 2026-08-13 against openai/gpt-4o-mini; LangSmith experiment atlas.15c1.heldout.67ff260be9b8-53559ce0. This 20-case / 23-claim set is a bounded calibration, not statistical proof. The unclear class has only two human-labeled claims. One OpenAI model/configuration was evaluated. Passing the calibration gate does not automatically freeze evaluation.v1. On 2026-08-13 the project owner explicitly froze evaluation.v1, accepting those bounded-calibration limitations.
_meta.note: Held out from grader development. The project owner approved the proposed labels on 2026-08-13 (human_reviewed is true). Approval occurred before predictions. Labels were not modified after predictions. Live calibration has run. Automated criteria passed. Human systematic-failure review passed (no unexplained systematic failure). The frozen calibration gate passed. Promotion criteria must not automatically create evaluation.v1. The project owner separately froze evaluation.v1 on 2026-08-13, accepting the bounded calibration evidence and limitations.

claims.text: Port Meridian's 2024 compost ordinance requires households to separate food scraps from landfill waste.

excerpts.text: Adopted in March 2024, Port Meridian Ordinance 18-C requires every household to separate food scraps from landfill waste and place them in the city compost cart.

claims.rationale: The excerpt states the same ordinance, year, city, and household food-scrap separation duty.

human.rationale: Single fully supported claim; mean is 1.00 and passes.

claims.text: The 2025 North Bank herring quota increased to 80,000 tonnes.

excerpts.text: The North Bank salmon hatchery received a 2025 maintenance grant to replace two aging raceways. No marine harvest figures are discussed.

claims.rationale: Evidence is silent on herring and on any quota; a hatchery grant does not support the claim.

human.rationale: Single unsupported claim; mean is 0.00 and fails.

claims.text: The 2023 Camp Holt survey found both a 4.1 percent mass loss and a newly opened visitor center.

excerpts.text: The 2023 Camp Holt stake network measured a 4.1 percent glacier mass loss versus the 2019 baseline. The report does not mention buildings or visitor facilities.

claims.rationale: Mass-loss half of the compound claim is present; the visitor-center half is absent, so support is only partial.

human.rationale: Partial compound claim scores 0.50; mean fails the 0.70 threshold.

claims.text: Fewer than one in ten rural addresses in County Hale still lack fiber.

excerpts.text: Fiber now reaches 91 percent of rural County Hale premises, according to the 2024 connectivity census.

claims.rationale: 91 percent reached is semantically equivalent to fewer than 10 percent lacking fiber, with the same county and rural scope.

human.rationale: Paraphrase of a supported statistic; mean 0.90 passes.

claims.text: Clinic loggers kept the vaccine refrigerators at 8 C for 72 hours during the June outage.

excerpts.text: During the June power outage, clinic loggers recorded refrigerator air temperature of 8 C for 11 hours before backup power restored the set point.

claims.rationale: Temperature matches but duration 11 hours contradicts 72 hours; the numeric mismatch defeats support.

human.rationale: Contradictory duration; mean 0.10 fails.

claims.text: Charcoal dates show the ridge kiln was last fired in 1180 CE.

excerpts.text: Short-lived charcoal from the ridge kiln's last firing cluster between 940 and 980 CE (2-sigma). No medieval twelfth-century dates were obtained.

claims.rationale: The dated firing is two centuries earlier than 1180 CE; the claim is contradicted.

human.rationale: Date contradiction; mean 0.05 fails.

claims.text: Harbor Point's new terminal handles 12 million TEU per year.

excerpts.text: Seacliff Harbor's rebuilt terminal is rated for 12 million TEU annually. Harbor Point is mentioned only as a ferry stop with no container yard.

claims.rationale: The TEU figure belongs to Seacliff Harbor, not Harbor Point; entity substitution is unsupported.

human.rationale: Wrong entity; mean 0.10 fails.

claims.text: Port Meridian's compost program reduced landfill tonnage by 18 percent in 2024.

excerpts.text: In 2024 Port Meridian expanded compost cart collection to Tuesdays and Fridays. The notice does not report landfill tonnage or diversion rates.

claims.rationale: Same program and year, but collection-day expansion does not support an 18 percent landfill reduction.

human.rationale: Topical overlap without the claimed metric; mean 0.15 fails.

claims.text: Lake Arden's summer 2024 phosphorus stayed below 20 micrograms per liter.

excerpts.text: Lake Arden's June 2024 mean total phosphorus was 14 micrograms per liter, below the 20 microgram recreation target.
An August 2024 bloom on Lake Arden coincided with mean total phosphorus of 41 micrograms per liter.

claims.rationale: The August value of 41 micrograms per liter directly contradicts the claim that phosphorus stayed below 20 throughout summer.

human.rationale: Single unsupported claim; Atlas mean is 0.10 and fails.

claims.text: The new trail cut travel time between Oak Ferry and Red Knoll in half.

excerpts.text: A public trail now connects Oak Ferry with Red Knoll. Opening remarks mentioned convenience but gave no travel-time measurements.

claims.rationale: The evidence is silent on travel-time measurements and therefore does not support the claimed 50 percent reduction.

human.rationale: Single unsupported claim; Atlas mean is 0.15 and fails.

claims.text: Ridgeford's 2024 heat-pump rebate paid 2,400 dollars per qualifying home.
The same rebate required a sealed building envelope test before payout.
Applications opened on 1 April 2024 and closed on 30 September 2024.
Ridgeford also built a 200-megawatt solar farm under the same ordinance.

excerpts.text: Ridgeford Resolution 2024-11 set a 2,400 dollar heat-pump rebate for qualifying homes. It does not authorize utility-scale solar construction.
Rebate payouts required a passing sealed-envelope blower-door test recorded on the application file.
The 2024 heat-pump rebate accepted applications from 1 April through 30 September.

claims.rationale: Rebate amount and city match the excerpt.
Envelope test requirement is explicitly stated.
Application window dates match exactly.
The rebate excerpt denies utility-scale solar; the claim is unsupported.

human.rationale: Three supported claims and one unsupported yield mean 0.75, which still passes. An unsupported claim does not veto the mean.

claims.text: Route 12 evening headways became 15 minutes on weekdays in 2024.
Weekday ridership on Route 12 doubled after the headway change.

excerpts.text: In 2024, weekday evening Route 12 buses were scheduled every 15 minutes. The timetable circular does not include ridership counts.

claims.rationale: Headway, route, weekday evening, and year match.
No ridership evidence; doubling is unsupported.

human.rationale: Mean of 1.00 and 0.00 is 0.50, which fails.

claims.text: The 2024 roadside biochar plots proved that corn yield doubled.

excerpts.text: A preliminary 2024 roadside biochar plot suggested corn yield might increase. The authors wrote that the results were not conclusive and that a doubled yield had not been demonstrated.

claims.rationale: The evidence explicitly says doubled yield was not demonstrated, contradicting the claim that it was proved.

human.rationale: Single unsupported claim; Atlas mean is 0.10 and fails.

claims.text: Downtown Westmere occupancy averaged 92 percent throughout 2024.

excerpts.text: Downtown Westmere occupancy was 92 percent in October 2024, the only month published in the snapshot.

claims.rationale: One month at 92 percent does not establish a year-long average of 92 percent.

human.rationale: Time-window mismatch leaves the claim only partially evidenced; mean 0.50 fails.
